evidence.name: Screen field: Purchase button text alignment
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Purchase button text alignment" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Purchase button text alignment
sections.description: Sets where the label sits inside the button: start (left in left-to-right languages), center, or end (right). Center is the standard choice and is recommended for a call-to-action so the label reads as one clear, balanced action.
